app.title: DTC4EU Platform
app.tagline: Democratic Therapeutic Communities for Social Inclusion

cycle.label: Cycle
cycle.readOnly: This cycle is {{status}} — data is read-only
cycle.banner: You are working in cycle {{cycle}} ({{status}}). Every list and form below belongs to this cycle.

common.noResults: No results match the current filters
common.required: Please fill in the required fields

dashboard.intro: Use the sidebar to work with facilities, ternas and questionnaires for the selected annual cycle.

history.title: Accreditation history
history.cyclesInProgramme: Annual cycles in the accreditation programme: {{count}}

documents.title: Quality documents (this cycle)
documents.codeHint: Pattern {TYPE} CT{n}-{suffix}, e.g. GPP CT4-LC (suffix list pending client confirmation)

qcncBoard.intro: Conformity / Non-Conformity per quality standard (each standard is answered C or NC only), over the three administrations of the cycle, in the order they are done: the Internal Facilitator's self-assessment before the visits begin, the Terna Coordinators' assessment for the visiting delegation after the visit, and the Terna Coordinator's own assessment at the end of all three visits.
qcncBoard.metaEmpty: Computed once all three administrations are recorded.

metaAreas.title: Qualitative meta-areas
metaAreas.hint: Counts the standards that count for the meta-areas (7 per quality standard) marked C in each administration. A meta-area is a strength when all are C, and a weakness when fewer than half are, in all three administrations. Its DTCRO areas become the facility's qualitative strength or weakness areas in the Summary Table.

gasset.intro: Structured GAS-Set (Setting Analysis Grid) — sections A–N transcribed verbatim from the 2026 corrected edition. Saved automatically while you type; Section N (per-user clinical data) is visible only to clinical-access roles.

effectiveness.title: GPP effectiveness (Module 6)
effectiveness.hint: Link the corresponding questionnaire item; effectiveness levels are snapshotted from this facility's computed scores. Mapping semantics are an open question with the client.

manualEp.title: Manual Excellence Points
manualEp.hint: For questionnaires the engine does not compute (e.g. ViVaCom) and for historical cycles. Labels are stored verbatim, separated by ';'.

facilitator.help: The Internal Facilitator completes the GAS-Set, the QCNC self-assessment and the DTCRO Long Form for this facility in this cycle, and manages the member codes. Assigning a person gives them access to this facility’s data. Only users with the Internal Facilitator role can be chosen.

ternas.title: Ternas
ternas.coordinatorRule: TCS ternas have 2 coordinators; GAS/SHS have 1

analytics.benchmarksHint: Per recovery area, the best final area score among the terna's three facilities.
analytics.populationHint: Collected submitted questionnaires vs the pseudonymous member roster, per category.
analytics.saveTernaFirst: Save the terna first to see its analytics.

ternas.facilitatorTwice: The same person is Internal Facilitator for two of these facilities. Check that this is intended.

questionnaires.title: Questionnaires
questionnaires.name: Name
questionnaires.previewHint: Preview: this is what respondents see. Nothing you enter here is saved.
questionnaires.searchItems: Search by code, text or area
questionnaires.lockedHint: This questionnaire already has responses, so its items, scale and bands are locked.
questionnaires.bandsHint: A score up to "Critical up to" is critical; from "Efficacy from" it is efficacy; in between it is intermediate. Leave both empty to keep the current bands. Without bands, scores are not classified.
questionnaires.bandsBoth: Fill in both band limits, or neither.
questionnaires.scaleLocked: Locked: answers already given on this scale.

facilityInstruments.title: Facility instruments
facilityInstruments.intro: These are completed per facility, in the facility’s own page. Choose a facility to open it in cycle {{cycle}}.

gasSet.name: GAS-Set (Setting Analysis Grid)
gasSet.about: Completed by the Internal Facilitator once per cycle: the structured description of the facility (sections A–N).

qcnc.name: QCNC (Conformity / Non-Conformity)
qcnc.about: Q1–Q5 standards, marked C or NC in three administrations: the Internal Facilitator’s self-assessment before the visits, the delegation’s after the visit, and the Terna Coordinator’s own after all three visits.

qualityDocuments.name: Quality Document Assessment Form
qualityDocuments.about: The GPP / CGS / EEN documents a facility applies, each assessed by a named assessor. Found in the facility’s Participation tab.

questionnaires.qcncPreviewHint: Preview of the QCNC standards. In the facility’s QCNC tab each standard is marked C or NC three times: by the Internal Facilitator before the visits, for the visiting delegation after the visit, and by a Terna Coordinator after all three visits.

responses.title: Responses
responses.submitConfirm: Submit this response? Answers become read-only and area scores are computed.
responses.missingRequired: All Likert items must be answered before submitting
responses.readOnlySubmitted: This response was submitted and is read-only
responses.pseudonymHint: Subjects are identified by pseudonymous codes only — never personal names.
responses.researchExportHint: Pick a questionnaire first — the export has one column per item

import.title: Import paper questionnaires
import.hint: Download the XLSX template for a form, enter one paper questionnaire per row (subject code, header fields, item values), then upload it. The file is checked row by row; nothing is imported while any row has an error. Complete rows are submitted, incomplete ones are kept as drafts.

scoring.title: Computed scores
scoring.noData: No submitted responses for this facility and cycle yet — scores appear after the first submit.

summary.title: Summary table — annual cycle
summary.hint: Qualitative area rows await the client's cluster-level QCNC rule; standard-level C/NC entry lives on the facility's QCNC tab. EP-Bench's exact rule is an open question with the client.

admin.passwordHint: Leave empty to keep the current password
admin.scopeHint: Internal facilitators, evaluators and audit coordinators see only their facilities. Terna coordinators see their ternas and build new ternas only from the facilities ticked here. Respondents can answer questionnaires only for the facilities ticked here, without seeing their data.
admin.overlapHint: Cycles span 16 months (Sep 1 → Dec 31 of the following year) and adjacent cycles overlap — several cycles can be OPEN at once.
admin.ordinalHint: The cycle number is worked out from the start date. A facility’s history shows its own count ("1st", "2nd", …).
admin.facilitatesNone: No facility in this cycle yet.
admin.facilitatesHint: To assign one, open a facility’s Participation tab, or pick the facilitator in a terna.
admin.temporaryPassword: Temporary password: the user must choose a new one at first login
admin.defaultCycleHint: Optionally mark one cycle as the default that everyone lands in on their first visit; afterwards each user stays in the cycle they last chose.

audits.title: Quality Audits
audits.subtitle: Module 3 — audits of the selected cycle (Simple / BQ / CGQ). Assigned audit coordinators automatically gain access to the audited facility.
audits.empty: No audits recorded in this cycle.
audits.coordinatorHint: Users with the Audit Coordinator role; assignment auto-grants facility access.
audits.noRoleUsers: No users hold this role yet — create them under Users.
audits.confirmDelete: Delete this audit? This cannot be undone.

rules.title: Assignment rules
rules.subtitle: Which questionnaire form each respondent receives. Every active rule whose conditions match a respondent's profile assigns its form. The client's assignment matrix is entered here; nothing is hardcoded.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Until rules exist, respondents see no questionnaires.
rules.name: Name
rules.conditionsHint: Combine conditions with AND (all must match) or OR (any may match). Groups can be nested. Several values in one condition mean "any of these".
rules.requiredFields: A name and an assigned form are required.
rules.deleteMessage: Delete the rule "{{name}}"? Respondents it assigned a form to will no longer see that form unless another rule assigns it.
rules.testHint: Enter a sample profile to see which forms the active rules would assign today. Separate several values with commas.

my.title: Your questionnaires
my.subtitle: Only the questionnaires assigned to you are listed. You can save and come back later.
my.none: No questionnaire is assigned to you at the moment.
my.profileHint: Please check your details for this cycle before continuing. They decide which questionnaires you receive.
my.privacyNote: We never ask for your name. Your answers are stored under a code only.
my.subjectCodeHint: The code your Internal Facilitator gave you, for example U-07. Do not enter your name.

progress.todoTitle: What you need to complete in cycle {{cycle}}
progress.overviewTitle: Completion across all ternas in cycle {{cycle}}
progress.legend: Click a status to open the form. Done = checklist OK or form submitted; in progress = something saved.
progress.nothing: Nothing assigned to you in cycle {{cycle}}.

account.title: Change password
account.forcedIntro: Your password is temporary or has been shared. Choose a new one to continue.
account.rules: At least 10 characters. It must differ from the current one and must not contain your username.
account.mismatch: The two passwords do not match
